text:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up — nightly-sweeper on sw-23 blew up during the cleanup phase. Observed steady memory growth for ~2h then process restart. Not a typical OOM (no cgroups kill) — looks like leaked fds or retained tensors.

Aisha Khan: quick log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-16T05:12:34Z] sweeper: started pass id=9421
[2026-03-16T05:34:10Z] sweeper: processed shard=17 mem=1.2GB
[2026-03-16T06:02:01Z] sweeper: processed shard=18 mem=2.7GB
[2026-03-16T06:42:10Z] sweeper: processed shard=19 mem=5.9GB
[2026-03-16T06:45:02Z] sweeper: restarting due to memory pressure (self-restart)
```

Tom B: tagging ops — @ops — can you grab the heap/profile when you get a sec? :eyes:

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4521 — assigned to infra-oncall. Collecting diagnostics.

Ravi Patel: Can we rerun the job with debug heap flags and a smaller shard window? I want to see allocation stacks. If it's kvcache GC deciding to keep things, reducing concurrency might surface it faster.

Aisha Khan: Started manual rerun: rerun-id=rerun-23321, with --shard-window=1 --max-cache=1GB, enabled `--alloc-trace` to capture backtraces. Holding other sweeps.

ci-bot: rerun-23321 started on sw-23 at 2026-03-16T07:05:10Z

ci-bot: rerun-23321 failed after 00:46:12 — memory grew to 7.2GB, collected alloc traces at /tmp/rerun-23321/alloc.tar.gz

Tom B: alloc traces look like a lot of retained buffers from model polling path — possibly a regression in the polling client that buffers responses without releasing. Any recent changes to poller or shared buffer pool?

Ravi Patel: I pushed poller refactor in 2026-03-15 (build 2026.03.15-7). Rolling a bisect between builds 2026.03.14-3 and 2026.03.15-7 makes sense. I'll start the binary bisect and add a test that stresses repeated small fetches.

Aisha Khan: Temporary mitigation: added `sweeper.restart_on_high_water=true` and `sweeper.max_cache_mb=1024` in canary config for staging and dedicated pool. Also increasing GC frequency on sw-23. Will monitor next 2 runs.

Tom B: Assigning action items:
- Ravi: run bisect and post commit range + first bad build here.
- Ops: grab `gcore` or heap profile on next failure and upload to INC-4521.
- Aisha: leave rerun disabled for other regions until resolved.

Aisha Khan: Thanks all — please keep updates in this thread. If anyone sees a quick revert candidate, ping me and I'll promote the patch to hotfix. :thumbsup:
